name: near Tiruvarur (30 km)

dry_spells.source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 via NASA GES DISC Giovanni, 2001-2024
dry_spells.definition: longest run of days < 2.5 mm in the 30 days starting the 1st of the sowing month

ne_onset.method: first day from 10 Oct with >= 20 mm over 3 days and no 10+ day dry spell (< 2.5 mm) in the next 30 days (agro-meteorological onset; IMD's official onset uses winds and coastal stations)

sowing_rain_onset.method: same rule searching from 15 Sep: first reliable sowing rains (includes late southwest-monsoon / transition rain used for Purattasi-pattam sowing)

canal_index.source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 via NASA GES DISC Giovanni; June-September totals (mm) at upper-Cauvery catchment points (Western Ghats, Karnataka/Kerala) that feed Mettur dam
canal_index.method: 0.6 x this year's + 0.4 x last year's June-September IMERG rain over the upper-Cauvery catchment (each divided by the 2001-2024 mean); the 0.4 term stands for Mettur storage carry-over

dam.name: Mettur (Stanley) reservoir, Cauvery delta canals
dam.source: Tamil Nadu Dept of Agriculture, Season & Crop statistics tables VII.10 (Mettur opening & closing details) and VII.12 (Mettur opening date vs paddy area), tnagriculture.in/dashboard/report/
notes: 2016: paddy-area row has release date 20.09.2017 (other year), areas skipped

groundwater.source: NASA GLDAS-2.2 CLSM 0.25 deg daily with GRACE data assimilation (GLDAS_CLSM025_DA1_D.2.2, doi 10.5067/TXBMLX370XX8), GWS_tavg, via Giovanni
groundwater.note: GRACE resolves ~300 km; read as regional groundwater change, not one village's wells

precip_source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 at 11.05N 79.55E (0.1° grid); temperature/ET0 from NASA POWER
